w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: Back at the haven the argument starts: Peyton is calling it "Old Gavel." The name's up for grabs — weigh in if you want.

w3Mentions.name: The Focus Group
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Focus Group.

w3Mentions.name: Chorus Line
w3Mentions.firstLine: ⚔ CHORUS LINE! You're on your own.

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Cancellation
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
firstContext: You work the patch with practiced hands: 8× White Oak Acorns (in shell — shell them to eat). You also gather deadfall: 1× branches, 1× bark fiber. This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.
Something moves out there — The Cancellation.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.
You turn to leave — behind you, The Cancellation stirs.

w5Mentions.name: The Editor
w5Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Editor.
firstContext: Your pack is full. Eat something, test a lump from your pack, or leave some for the woods.
Something moves out there — The Editor.
👁️ Ines freezes — hand up. "Something's out there. Big. We see it before it sees us — that's our edge. Use it."
Still full. (Eat, test a lump, or leave some.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: It's settled. The village is calling it "Big Big." The Codex keeps it.
◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
⚠ DEHYDRATED: find and treat water today.

loss.line: No one is left to pick up the Codex. The village dies out — quietly, the way villages do. The season ends here.
